purpose: Preserve the reproducible ANA RD 0525-2023 archive while fail-closing its earlier semantic binding to the Jicamarca Río Seco child. The archived 270-hito table is explicitly labelled Qda. Colca in the resolution, while independent IGP research treats Colca and Río Seco as distinct local tributaries. The frozen faja therefore remains valid source evidence only for Qda. Colca regulatory context and MUST NOT be used as Río Seco channel, catchment, outlet, confluence, event footprint or routing evidence.

nomenclature_conflict.igp_bounded_finding: The IGP study explicitly lists Colca, El Silencio and Río Seco as distinct tributary components within the Jicamarca study area.

official_identity.official_relation_note: ANA RD 0525-2023 is titled for Río Seco and nine tributaries, but the frozen 270-hito / 26 km table is labelled Quebrada Colca. Independent IGP evidence treats Colca and Río Seco as distinct components, so no equivalence is admissible.
official_identity.project_context: Mejoramiento y ampliación del servicio de protección ante inundaciones y movimiento de masas en la quebrada Huaycoloro
